question: Entry-policy dry run B
purpose: Test whether a standalone benchmark with its own decision remains structurally admissible, without a Gate 1 claim.

task_search.heldout_rule: Hold out an independent seed and retain failed calibrations.

branches.success: Admit only this benchmark configuration for its separate domain study.
branches.failure: Close this benchmark configuration and keep the negative result.
branches.borderline: Keep the configuration unqualified without tuning its threshold.
